description: Issue a draft invoice — the invoice page's Confirm. The invoice is numbered (if it has no number yet), its quantities are billed on the sales order it came from, and connected accounting integrations receive it. An issued invoice can no longer be edited. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

invoiceId.description: Draft invoice id (GUID) or number from list_invoices.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

name: issue_invoice
title: Issue Invoice
